title: All items totems
description: This datapack will transform all your Minecraft items into totems of undying.
body: This datapack will transform all your Minecraft items into totems of undying. At the very beginning of the game, you might not be thinking about how to beat the game and acquire totems, but rather about making a stack of sticks, which will act as totems of immortality. You might have seen this on TikTok, and now you can play with it yourself.
